verdict.rationale: RingCentral's Business SMS Booster add-on is documented as managing customer texts through a shared inbox, which covers texts landing where the team can see them. The evidence is a single marketing-level line, and nothing shows team members can see who replied to a given text. missing for 10: evidence of per-agent reply attribution in the shared inbox, in-depth first-party docs on how texts to the business number route into the inbox, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied

citations.quote: Business SMS Booster Manage customer texts with a shared inbox, templates, and compliance tools.
